name: media-between-text

frames.best_why: Frame 6 has the sentence with the sunrise photo fully open between the brackets.

tagline: Hover the sentence and a photo grows out between two brackets.
summary: A headline-sized sentence whose middle brackets widen on hover to slide in a photo or video, then close again when the pointer leaves. It can also open on scroll into view or on a ref call.
appearance: One line of large, light-weight coral text with a bare pair of brackets mid-sentence, on a black stage above a tiny grey hint. Opened, a small landscape photo fills the space the brackets frame and the words spread to either side.
behaviour: On hover the gap between the brackets widens over about half a second on a spring to reveal the media, and leaving shrinks it back to nothing. A configured scroll-into-view or a ref call can play the same opening without a pointer.
demo_content: The line "that's a nice ( ) view!" with a mountain photo at sunrise.
search_phrases: image appears inside a sentence on hover
headline with photo in the middle
text splits to show a picture
sentence with a gap that opens
hover text that parts for media
use_when: A single striking headline on a landing page should carry a photo or clip inside the copy itself.
avoid_when: The hidden media gives no hint it is there, so on touch screens the effect never triggers.
customise: Set the two text halves, the media URL and type, and the trigger through props; the reveal width, duration and spring live in the variants, and the media box size comes from a class.
weight_why: Two text nodes and one image or video that only animates while hovered.

a11y.note: Hover is the only default trigger and the sentence is not focusable, so keyboard users cannot open the media.

issues: The media box has no intrinsic size, so without a width and height class the picture never shows.
Closed, the empty brackets read like a typo unless the tiny hint line explains the hover.
polish_why: Striking inline reveal with a smooth spring; the bare brackets look odd until hovered.
title: Media Between Text
